items.title: Gemini Workspace Framework – Sustainable AI-Assisted Development
items.raw_excerpt:
AI coding tools excel at generation but fail at organization. Most demos built in 10 minutes become unmaintainable in 6 months.
This framework addresses that gap. It provides:
• Tiered complexity model (Lite/Standard/Enterprise) - match structure to project scale
• Skills + Workflows architecture - reusable automation across projects • AI-optimized documentation (GEMINI.md) - reduce iteration cycles
• Consistent patterns - same structure across all projects
The focus isn't "code faster" - it's "build sustainably." Code is written once, modified dozens of times.
Built this after watching too many AI-generated projects devolve into "vibe coding" - ad-hoc files with no structure that compound chaos with every feature.
Open to feedback from folks building AI-assisted systems at scale.

excerpt_i18n.en: The AI wave is here, where are my opportunities? How can I make money? Over the past year and a half, these have been the most pressing questions on the minds of every partner in the Tencent Cloud ecosystem. Their attention has unanimously turned to Yang Chen, the new head of Tencent Cloud's Industry Ecosystem Cooperation Department, who took office in May 2024. As the key interface and "chief captain" between Tencent Cloud and its vast network of partners, his core mission is clear and daunting: to chart a new course for partners in the waves of AI and global expansion—one that ensures not only survival but also sustainable profitability. At the time, the answers in the market seemed straightforward: either compete for large GPU computing power contracts or sell trendy MaaS model services, both widely regarded as industry "fast lanes." However, Yang Chen quickly dismissed these options, opting instead for a path less traveled by other players but more aligned with Tencent's DNA: AI SaaS. Over his 500 days in office, how has he guided partners of varying scales and backgrounds through this seemingly "counter-consensus" and challenging pivot? Recently, during the 2026 Tencent Cloud Partners Conference, Leiphone engaged in multiple in-depth discussions with Yang Chen, aiming to outline the critical decisions and practical strategies shaping the future of the ecosystem. Not long ago, Leiphone and Tencent Cloud co-organized a roundtable dialogue on Tencent Cloud's ecosystem and its partners. From left to right: Cheng Xiaozhong, Founder & CEO of AnChang; Chai Yifei, CEO of Huayu Jiaye; Yang Chen, Head of Tencent Cloud Industry Ecosystem Cooperation Business; Guo Haozhe, Chairman of Donghua Cloud. In the battle of AI, Tencent Cloud's ecosystem has chosen to start with AI S
excerpt_i18n.es: La ola de la IA ha llegado, ¿dónde está mi oportunidad? ¿Cómo puedo ganar dinero? Estas han sido las preguntas más urgentes que han rondado en la mente de cada socio del ecosistema de Tencent Cloud durante el último año y medio. Sus miradas se han dirigido, sin excepción, hacia Yang Chen, el nuevo responsable del Departamento de Cooperación en el Ecosistema Industrial de Tencent Cloud, quien asumió el cargo en mayo de 2024. Como interfaz clave y "capitán general" entre Tencent Cloud y sus innumerables socios, su misión central es clara y ardua: en medio de las grandes olas de la IA y la expansión global, encontrar para los socios un nuevo rumbo que no solo les permita sobrevivir, sino también generar ingresos de manera sostenible. En ese momento, las respuestas en el mercado parecían claras: ya sea competir por grandes contratos de capacidad de cómputo con GPU, o vender los modernos servicios de modelos MaaS.

excerpt_i18n.en: Each company has its own distinct DNA and constitution; Tencent's approach is steady and methodical. At Tencent's 2026 employee meeting, addressing external AI anxiety, Chairman and CEO Ma Huateng began by reassuring the entire staff, emphasizing the need to maintain composure and focus on the company's own pace. Over the past year, Tencent's Hunyuan large model underwent a "deep restructuring." Ma Huateng revealed that after Yao Shunyu (Tencent's Chief AI Scientist) joined, the company accelerated efforts to attract talent, restructured the R&D team, and internally expedited Co-design to strengthen the synergy between the Hunyuan large model and Yuanbao. He noted that Tencent Hunyuan made significant changes last year in talent attraction and organizational structure, drawing more native AI talent. On December 17, 2025, Tencent announced an upgrade to its large model R&D framework, establishing new departments: AI Infra, AI Data, and Data Computing Platform. Former OpenAI senior researcher Yao Shunyu was appointed Chief AI Scientist in the CEO/President's Office (reporting to Liu Chiping), while also heading the AI Infra and Large Language Model departments (reporting to Lu Shan). This move was defined as a clear signal of Tencent's accelerated AI strategy, with Yao Shunyu becoming the core leader of Tencent Hunyuan's large model R&D. According to Leifeng.com, in January last year, Tencent's AI assistant "Yuanbao" team transitioned from TEG (Technology and Engineering Group) to CSIG, evolving from a "technology testing ground" to an "AI application pioneer."
excerpt_i18n.es: Cada empresa tiene un ADN y una constitución diferentes; el estilo de Tencent es sólido y constante. En la asamblea de empleados de Tencent en 2026, ante la ansiedad externa por la IA, Ma Huateng, presidente del consejo de administración y director ejecutivo de Tencent, tranquilizó a todo el personal desde el principio, enfatizando la necesidad de mantener la calma y concentrarse en el propio ritmo. En el último año, el modelo de gran lenguaje Hunyuan de Tencent experimentó una reestructuración profunda. Después de la incorporación de Yao Shunyu, científico jefe de IA de Tencent, la empresa aceleró la atracción de talento, reorganizó el equipo de investigación y desarrollo, y promovió internamente el diseño Co-design, fortaleciendo la sinergia entre el modelo Hunyuan y Yuanbao.
